name: TS6-Manager-Backend
description: TS6 Manager Backend - Express API of the TS6 Manager stack (web management for TeamSpeak via WebQuery HTTP, music bots, bot flows, server widgets). STACK: Requires TS6-Manager-Frontend (web UI) and TS6-Manager-Sidecar (video streaming). Install Sidecar first, then Backend, then Frontend. REQUIRED: Set JWT_SECRET to a random value of at least 32 characters - the backend refuses to start without it. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 32

paths.name: Data
paths.description: SQLite database (users, server connections, bots, flows, widgets) and the YouTube cookie file uploaded in the UI.

paths.name: Music
paths.description: Music library: uploaded files and tracks downloaded via yt-dlp.

ports.name: API
ports.description: Backend API and WebSocket. The frontend reaches it through this host port - keep it closed to the internet.

variables.name: JWT secret
variables.description: REQUIRED. Random secret (min. 32 characters) for signing login tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: Encryption key
variables.description: Recommended. Key for AES-256-GCM encryption of stored API keys and SSH passwords. Falls back to JWT_SECRET if empty. Do not change it later - stored credentials can no longer be decrypted.

variables.name: Frontend URL
variables.description: URL you open the web UI with. Used as allowed CORS origin. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP (or set your reverse-proxy domain).

variables.name: Allow self-signed certificates
variables.description: Set to 'true' if your TeamSpeak WebQuery runs over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate.

variables.name: Sidecar URL
variables.description: Address of the TS6-Manager-Sidecar. The default works together with the --add-host entry in Extra Parameters. Only change it if your sidecar runs elsewhere.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: SQLite database path inside the container. Leave as is.

variables.name: Music directory
variables.description: Music directory inside the container. Leave as is.

variables.name: API port
variables.description: Internal API port. Must stay 3001 - the frontend's nginx proxies to backend:3001.

variables.name: Refresh token lifetime
variables.description: Lifetime of refresh tokens (how long you stay logged in).

variables.name: Container timezone
variables.description: Container timezone. Note: cron triggers in bot flows do not use it - they have their own timezone field (default UTC).
